TrackersPdfGenerator.jsx is 483 lines and packs all 54 slide bodies into a single file — splitting by sections (intro / emergent / closing) would improve maintainability, per <code_review_gudielines> on file size.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Slides counter format uses non-breaking spaces (` / `); when asserting against document.body.innerText use a regex like /\d{2}\s*\/\s*54/ rather than a plain '34 / 54' substring. Slides at positions 43 (TASlide42Emergent) and 54 (TASlide51HumanRole) are cover-style centered slides with NO counter header — that's intentional. The slide array in /app/frontend/src/pages/TrackersPresentation.jsx and the TADoc render order in /app/frontend/src/components/TrackersPdfGenerator.jsx (line 470-471) are aligned. When clicking dots in isolation right after initial load, give the page ~1s wait before the first click; sequential clicks work fine with 180ms between them.
